verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe fetched a machine-readable OpenAPI JSON document (HTTP 200, application/json) for AI Services API v2 covering the six Scribe paths. Zoom's own API reference also identifies the API as OpenAPI-described, and llms.txt links an API catalog. missing for 10: first-party docs explicitly pointing users to the spec download, and consistent spec versioning (the docs say OpenAPI 3.1.1 while the served payload declares 3.0.0).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 application/json at https://developers.zoom.us/api/zoap/ai-services/methods/; the payload declares OpenAPI 3.0.0, AI Services API version 2, and six Scribe paths
Zoom's AI Services API reference identifies OpenAPI 3.1.1 and API version 2
